title: Karta AI Raises $3 Mn To Automate Inbound Calls For BFSI Players
hook_text: Karta AI just raised three million dollars.
script:
Karta AI just raised three million dollars.
PeerCapital led this seed funding round for the startup.
The company builds agentic software to automate inbound customer calls.
Their target market includes banking, financial services, and insurance firms.
These institutions typically handle massive volumes of routine customer queries daily.
Automated voice agents aim to reduce wait times and lower operating costs.
Would you trust an AI with your bank account?
